channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Following Accor split, Treebo targets 3,500-4,000 hotels in five years
item.description: The hotel company is doubling down on the ₹1,000-3,000 room-rate segment, where it sees an opportunity to organize a fragmented market through technology and centralized distribution.

item.title: Tata boardroom battle: Jimmy Tata backs Chandrasekaran, accuses Noel Tata of using Tata Trusts for takeover of Tata Sons
item.description: Jimmy Naval Tata has backed Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran amid tensions with Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata, calling for the company to be listed. He says listing would improve transparency, accountability and governance, and urges the RBI to set a firm deadline.

item.title: SC upholds NCLAT order to send Videocon insolvency case back for fresh bids
item.description: The challenge centred on how Vedanta group-backed Twin Star proposed to pay dissenting creditors of Videocon and whether the resolution plan complied with the IBC

item.title: SpaceX launch: After Starship’s spectacular midair catch, Musk’s firm to launch Falcon 9 on Thursday
item.description: SpaceX plans to launch the classified USSF-317 mission from California aboard a Falcon 9, with the booster expected to land on a Pacific droneship. The launch follows Starship Flight 15, which achieved the first tower catch of a Starship upper stage.

item.title: AI startup Zelmier.com cuts discovery & bidding of government tenders to minutes
item.description: Founded by young entrepreneur Pranjal Srivastava, the startup aggregates tenders from 250+ prominent government portals and uses AI to match opportunities for businesses

item.title: Anthropic IPO: Why Google’s 13% stake and Big Tech’s $900-billion AI bet hinge on Claude maker’s success | Decoded
item.description: Anthropic’s planned IPO has become a major test for the AI industry, with tech giants investing $26 billion at the expected offering price and holding stakes in the company.&nbsp;

item.title: Anthropic promises to pursue humanitys benefit. Its IPO filing gives it wiggle room
item.description: Anthropic promises to pursue humanity's benefit. Its IPO filing gives it wiggle room

item.title: Indian PE, VC firms gear up to launch fresh funds post record $29.5 billion haul
item.description: PE-VC funds raised a record $29.5 billion in the first 10 months of 2026, drawing new fund launches even as LPs scrutinize realised returns and fund managers more closely.

item.title: Michigan pension fund drags Intel to court after 29% stock plunge in a day wiped out $140 billion in market value
item.description: Intel shareholders have filed a proposed class action, alleging the company concealed how slowing PC sales and excess inventory would hurt revenue. The suit says Intel disclosed the problems too late, before its stock plunged 28.6% in one day, wiping out about $140 billion in market value.

item.title: Embattled Jensen Huang is discussing comeback as Nvidia CEO amid mounting pressure on board to reinstate him: Report
item.description: A campaign is reportedly underway to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO days after his resignation amid allegations of extramarital relationships. Tech executives, investors and employees have voiced support, and allies are seeking White House backing.&nbsp;

item.title: Ola Electric's cash cushion dwindles as market share slips and losses persist
item.description: While the company's October rights issue of ₹1,000 crore, of which it has raised about ₹600 crore so far, will support its balance sheet, its existing loans of nearly ₹1,800 crore and rising quarterly losses mean its financial outlook remains uncertain.

item.title: Transasia BioMedicals explores minority stake sale to raise $200 million
item.description: The medical equipment maker is seeking $200 million through a minority stake sale, with TPG, Warburg Pincus, ChrysCapital and others exploring the opportunity.

item.title: Bharat Semi raises $24 million in seed round led by Info Edge, South Park Common
item.description: The deeptech startup is developing programmable sensors for applications spanning surveillance, automotive and drones, as it looks to build a global customer base.

item.title: IIFCL tightens loan terms as Yotta's debt tops $1.4 billion
item.description: While Yotta will initially rent out Nvidia’s B300 GPUs, these chips will have to be eventually purchased by Darshan Hiranandani, promoter of Yotta, as per the terms set by IIFCL.

item.title: With nine portfolio firms eyeing IPOs, Oister Global launches ₹600 cr deep-tech fund
item.description: Nearly 9 of the 17-18 companies across Oister Global’s three ACE funds, such as Kuku FM, OfBusiness, and Bombay Shaving Company, are looking to list

item.title: Jio explores Indian launch partners for satellite constellation; rocket capacity a hurdle
item.description: Jio is exploring domestic partners to launch satellites for a planned broadband constellation, with an initial batch of about 390 and a longer-term goal of 1,600. The effort could boost India’s private space sector, though limited launch capacity and high costs remain hurdles.

item.title: ULA Vulcan Rocket Launches With Its First Amazon Leo Payload
item.description: United Launch Alliance launched its Vulcan rocket for the first time in nine months, a long-awaited return for a vehicle plagued by delays and technical mishaps.

item.title: ‘Nvidia needs a dramatic shake-up’: Why Scott Bessent wants an outsider as CEO after Jensen Huang scandal
item.description: Scott Bessent questioned Nvidia’s corporate culture and its alleged role in facilitating the sale of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) chips to Chinese entities through shell companies, including those based in Singapore.

item.title: ‘The kitchen is at the heart of every household’: Why Ajinkya Rahane invested in cookware brand Ember
item.description: The investment marks Rahane's latest foray into India's startup ecosystem, adding another consumer-focused business to his investment portfolio.

item.title: Qualcomm layoffs: Who gets 4 months' salary and extra compensation under reported exit deal?
item.description: Qualcomm's India layoffs could affect 1,000 employees. Reports suggest affected staff may get up to four months' salary as severance, plus additional payouts.

item.title: Noel Tata reveals his idea of Tata way of life: ‘Charity precedes commerce, charity owns commerce; not other way around’
item.description: For Noel Tata, the central issue is not merely whether Tata Sons should be listed, but whether the Tata Group can preserve its founding philosophy of putting philanthropy and nation-building ahead of commercial considerations in a changing ownership structure.

item.title: AI makes 2 Indian-origin founders world’s youngest self-made billionaires worth ₹40,000 crore each, beats Zuckerberg
item.description: AI startup Mercor's three co-founders- Hiremath, chief technology officer; Midha, board chairman; and Brendan Foody, chief executive officer, hold 21% stakes in the company individually. Here's everything about them.

item.title: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left in 2025 as company conducts internal probe over Nvidia fallout
item.description: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left in 2025 as company conducts internal probe over Nvidia fallout

item.title: Jensen Huang controversy triggers fresh US push to block advanced AI chip exports to China — Report
item.description: Democrats and Republicans are backing bills to curb sensitive chip exports and give Congress greater powers to review and block deals approved by the Trump administration.

item.title: Raj Shamani beats Joe Rogan, Steven Bartlett to become YouTube’s top podcaster with 22 million subscribers
item.description: Raj Shamani began his podcast Figuring Out with Raj Shamani in 2021. The podcast has featured several high profile guests such as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Bill Gates, Vijay Mallya, French President Emmanuel Macron and more.

item.title: Saudi Arabia scraps VA Tech Wabag's ₹2,332 crore project: What went wrong with the Yanbu tender?
item.description: VA Tech Wabag said it was in the process of approaching the customer to obtain further clarity on the reasons behind the cancellation and understand the next course of action

item.title: Delhi tops pollution-linked health insurance claims, 90% from working professionals, senior citizens: Report
item.description: Pollution-linked health insurance claims have seen a rise of 4.3 times in the last three years, revealed Policybazaar. Between October and March, nearly 56% of these annual claims were made in FY26.

item.title: Jensen Huang's $140B Nvidia fortune isn't entirely his to control: How wife Lori, family trusts hold the keys — Details
item.description: The approximately 800 million shares jointly held through trusts and LLCs represent a substantial portion of the Huangs' Nvidia wealth. However, the different structures mean that not all these shares can necessarily be sold or transferred in the same way.

item.title: Standard Chartered taps GIFT City to help wealthy Indians diversify overseas
item.description: The launch follows an August approval from the IFSCA, GIFT City’s regulator, allowing the bank to distribute the funds to resident Indians. Launched four years ago, the funds manage $5 billion in assets across 13 markets.

item.title: Nvidia's bosses have $900 million insurance cover. How does Jensen Huang's scandal expose a gap?
item.description: Nvidia has $900 million insurance for executives but no company-level D&amp;O cover. Here's why the chipmaker could face costly shareholder lawsuits.

item.title: LPG cylinder price in Delhi: Why Ujjwala beneficiaries pay ₹642 for a cylinder that costs ₹1,267.24 to supply
item.description: Eligible Ujjwala beneficiaries pay ₹642 for a 14.2 kg LPG cylinder in Delhi, against the regular retail price of ₹942. The Centre provides a ₹300 direct subsidy and additional support of ₹325.24 per cylinder to cushion higher LPG costs.

item.title: Nvidia disruption, likely Democratic shift on data centres could impact AI investments, say experts. Who is set to gain?
item.description: Experts feel that the Nvidia turmoil and potential Democratic-led limits on data-center construction could redirect AI investment towards other chipmakers and Big Tech firms with available computing capacity. Does long-term growth outlook remain strong?

item.title: Jensen Huang spy scandal: Singapore-based Megaspeed breaks silence on Alice Huang, says she left the firm last year
item.description: Singapore-based Megaspeed, the company that recruited Alice Huang, broke its silence on the controversy on Sunday (local time). The company said she had left the firm in August last year.

item.title: ‘I hope you die…’: What ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told senior exec Jay Puri | A look at his temper tantrums
item.description: A report has shed light on Jensen Huang's alleged temper inside Nvidia, detailing how the former CEO reportedly berated senior executives, including Jay Puri, during meetings attended by dozens of employees.

item.title: Meet Hussain Sajwani, the Dubai investor who made more money from Anthropic in 2 years than his 30 years of investments
item.description: Hussain Sajwani, founder of Damac Properties, says his Anthropic investment has delivered extraordinary returns and expects billions in profit from stakes in Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceX. Damac Group invested $50 million in Anthropic in 2024 and has also backed xAI and Mistral.
